'''''Voyageurs''''' is the title of the 2003 [[novel in Scotland|novel by Scottish]] writer [[Margaret Elphinstone]]. It sets a young [[Quaker]] farmer from rural England in search of his missing missionary sister; he must work as a ''[[Coureur des bois#Voyageurs|voyageur]]'' to have any hope of finding her.
